name: Sheet overlap
rationale: The workbook has two sheets. Rows dated on or after the second sheet's first timestamp also appear in the first sheet (1-9 Dec 2010). The copy in the earlier sheet is dropped; the pipeline checks the two copies are identical first.

name: Exact-looking repeated line
rationale: Rows identical in all eight source fields are flagged for sensitivity analysis but retained. The source has no immutable line identifier, and high-multiplicity examples can represent legitimate repeated items; deletion is therefore not provable.

name: Missing key field
rationale: Invoice, stock code, timestamp, quantity or price is blank. The row cannot be attributed.

name: Non-product code
rationale: Postage, carriage, fees, manual adjustments, discounts, samples, bad debt, gift vouchers and test codes (see sql/seeds/non_product_codes.csv). They are not product sales, so they are outside the product revenue definition.

name: Zero price
rationale: Unit price is 0. In this data these are stock adjustments (damaged, missing, found) or free items. They carry no revenue but would distort units and prices.

name: Negative price
rationale: Unit price below 0. Accounting adjustments, not sales.

name: Non-positive quantity on a sales invoice
rationale: Invoice is not a cancellation but quantity is 0 or negative. Stock movements, not sales.

name: Non-negative quantity on a cancellation
rationale: Invoice starts with 'C' but quantity is 0 or positive. Inconsistent record.

name: Missing customer ID
rationale: Kept for revenue totals (customer_key = -1). Excluded from customer-level analysis (segments, cohorts, CLV).

name: Extreme line
rationale: Absolute quantity or absolute line value at or above the thresholds in config/settings.toml. Kept; analyses that are sensitive to outliers may exclude them and must say so.
